What's your return and refund policy?
You have 30 days from the date of your order to return your item. To be eligible for a return, the item must be in original, unworn condition with all original tags attached. Items that do not meet these conditions may not be accepted for return.
To qualify for a return:
Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in like-new condition.
All original tags, labels, and packaging must be included.
Proof of purchase is required (receipt, packing slip, or order confirmation email).
Shoes must be returned in their original shoe box, which should be placed inside a separate shipping container. We will not accept returns if the shoe box is used as the shipping container.
Refunds are generally issued to the original form of payment. If that payment method is no longer available, the refund will be provided as a gift card. For in-store returns of purchases made through PayPal, Afterpay, or Affirm, refunds will also be issued as a gift card. Cash refunds are not offered under any circumstances; if your original payment was made using cash, debit card, a gift card, or a third-party payment method, your refund will be issued as a gift card.
